I'm the author of TMSU. I've been working on TMSU during my weekly commute for several years now. It lets you tag your files using a commandline tool and then lets you kick up a virtual filesystem (VFS). The VFS contains directories for each of your tags and each tag directory contains symlinks back to your files. You can drill down into these tag directories to find the file you are looking for.

It's free and open-source. At present it works on Linux. (There is an old Windows build but it's a bit flaky (I really need to put some effort in here).

There's a quick tour on the homepage and there's more info on the wiki.
